checks: The publisher takes runtime inputs only and introduces no configuration binding, credential, environment host, fixed port, or deployment policy.
The post-commit coordinator marks only after confirmed publish completion and preserves the deliberate at-least-once boundary.
Current primary RabbitMQ sources verify the selected client APIs, confirmation tracking, channel serialization requirement, and 7.x package family.
The implementation separates outbox persistence, dispatch coordination, and RabbitMQ transport while deferring consumer/inbox/retry/domain semantics.
The test plan covers the bounded transport failure and race cases without claiming deferred consumer guarantees.
